scope: Pinned format facts; independently implemented. No upstream source linked or copied into production. Synthetic test vectors, no target hardware measurements.

decisions.xmp2_cas: Intel SPD4_CAS_LATENCIES_SUPPORTED_STRUCT defines CL7..24 in bits 0..17; higher bits reserved. Does not apply base SPD range-selector semantics. Explicit encoding label exposes this limited map.
decisions.xmp2_dimms: SPD_XMP_ORG_CONFIG: profile 1 bits 3:2 and profile 2 bits 5:4, code plus one. Recommended, not actual installed counts.
decisions.ddr5_channels: SPD_DDR5_COM_BUS_WIDTH_NCHAN is exponent 0..3, 1/2/4/8 subchannels. Other codes reserved.
decisions.ddr4_density: Codes 8/9 map to 12/24 Gbit, not powers of two.
decisions.stacked_capacity: topo_dimm.c capacity rule counts die layers only for 3DS logical ranks; non-3DS counts package ranks without another die multiplier. Only symmetric layouts implemented here.
decisions.ddr5_3ds_refresh: Base offsets 48/50/52: 16-bit little-endian ns, conditional on known 3DS package codes 2..5.
decisions.ddr5_revisions: Base major 1 and common module major 1 independently gated; common SPD revision at offset 192 governs rank/bus/channel geometry, not base 3DS refresh.
decisions.deferred: Asymmetric geometry, XMP 3.0 DIMM recommendations/user profiles, EXPO enhanced timings, active trained values and writes.
